title: A Day in the Life: 82nd ERQS Parachute Rigger
description: Aircrew flight equipment Airmen deployed to the 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron at Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti, work day and night behind the scenes to ensure the safety of our rescue Airmen. Part of their job is packing parachutes, which takes extraordinary attention to detail and is an essential part of supporting Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa rescue operations in East Africa. Here is an inside view of what they do to ensure each parachute is ready to go at a moments notice.
keywords: parachute rigger, AFE, Aircrew Flight Equipment, 82nd ERQS, rescue
